Bitget confirms $351.6M hot-wallet breach, suspends withdrawals –
Link
Bitget disclosed a hot-wallet breach of roughly $351.6M — about double the initial on-chain estimates — and suspended withdrawals pending review. Attackers have already swapped most EVM-chain proceeds into ≈67,982 ETH (≈$183M).
One of the biggest exchange breaches of 2026 so far. Expect this to weigh on confidence in centralized exchange security, and the swapped ETH adds fresh sell pressure.
